# Composio AgentAuth Reviews

### The community submitted 13 reviews to tell us what they like about Composio AgentAuth, what Composio AgentAuth can do better, and more.

5.0

Based on 13 reviews

Review Composio AgentAuth?

Reviewers describe Composio AgentAuth as a practical way to simplify authentication, permissions, and secure connections to external tools. The lone user review highlights an intuitive interface, easy setup of complex access levels, smooth integration with existing systems, solid API support, granular role controls, MFA, and responsive customer support. A founder of Crossnode adds that, for their product, it removed the burden of building many OAuth flows, handled end-user auth in white-labeled portals, and exposed action schemas their agents could use immediately.
